### YMCA turns crisis into capability at scale

YMCA partnered with Accenture to build a community-based model that helps refugees and displaced
people gain skills, find work, and rebuild their futures—moving from relief to long-term capability.

[
Read more
][135]

### How UNICEF's GenU is closing the youth skills gap

Through UNICEF’s partnership with Accenture, young people gain access to AI-powered skilling,
digital learning and entrepreneurship opportunities that connect them to employment and brighter
futures.

[
Read more
][136]

### Philipstown's wire cars go global

Philipstown’s wire car tradition is accelerating onto the global stage through immersive
storytelling, gaming and commerce—fueling opportunity and driving impact far beyond the track.

[
Read more
][137]

### Google Cloud reimagines lead enrichment with agentic AI

The leading hyperscaler replaced batch processing with an agentic model that delivers decision-ready
outputs up to 30x faster—sharpening prioritization while enabling more confident sales decisions.

[
Read more
][138]

### Bristol Myers Squibb scales AI to rewire everyday work

The life sciences leader is putting people at the center of its AI ambition—rewiring work across the
enterprise to empower employees, drive innovation and accelerate the delivery of therapies to
patients.

[
Read more
][139]

[ Meet Cencora ][86]
[A banner that says We Are Cencora on a pink and purple background]

# Marketplace gives pharmacies access to thousands of uniquely curated front-of-store products

We’re reimagining the procurement process by enabling pharmacies to source all the products they
need from front to back through one convenient platform.
[ Learn more ][87]
[A person viewing the Marketplace homepage on their laptop]

## We are united in our responsibility
## to create healthier futures.

As we pursue our purpose, we make a positive impact on the health of people and animals around the
world.

### Pharmaceutical distribution solutions

Our wholesale and specialty distribution services ensure that crucial medications efficiently,
reliably and securely reach their destinations every day.
[ Learn more ][88]
[AB_1Card_03]

### Manufacturer solutions

In addition to distribution and logistics, we help pharmaceutical manufacturers bring their products
to market – and assist with each step from pre-commercial and clinical trial to broad market
availability and patient adherence.
[ Learn more ][89]
[AB_2_3_Card_03]

### Provider solutions

Our solutions power patient care for pharmacies, physician practices, hospitals and health systems.
[ Learn more ][90]
[AB_2_3_Card_05]

### Animal health solutions

We deliver distribution, technology and innovation for veterinarians, livestock producers and
manufacturers to make a meaningful difference in their businesses and the health of animals.
[ Learn more ][91]

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

# Building a world of health around every individual

We connect people to the care they need, put medicine and wellness within reach, and drive greater
affordability, simplicity and convenience in everything we do.

## Combining our strengths for you

Health services Health insurance Pharmacy Prescription drug coverage

### Health services

We have an unmatched ability to reach people and provide them with access to the affordable, quality
health care and wellbeing services they need to live their healthiest lives.

[Explore our services ][110]

### Health insurance

Aetna® creates insurance plans that deliver a total, connected, affordable approach to health care.

[Discover Aetna plans ][111]

### Pharmacy

Our neighborhood pharmacies — as well as our prescription delivery and specialty medication services
— are making it as easy as possible for people to get the care they depend on.

[Visit our pharmacy page ][112]

### Prescription drug coverage

Our pharmacy benefit manager, CVS Caremark®, plays a critical role in the health care system by
helping to lower drug costs and expand coverage to the affordable medications people need to stay
healthy.

[Learn about drug coverage ][113]

### View transcript

Having 1 kid?...Not exactly simple.

Having 6 kids? Definitely not simple. Wait, that’s 8 people in one family. Whoa.

That means finding ONE tv show they’ll ALL watch.

Making ONE dinner they’ll ALL eat.

And how do you play a board game with 6 kids?…actually, that’s kinda simple.

Okaaay, not so simple.

But it’s not just tantrums.

It’s attitudes.

That’s right. Teenagers.

And how do you decide who gets the last piece of pizza?

But you don’t just have 6 kids, you have 6 kids all with chronic illnesses.

That means on top of it all, you have to manage over 50 prescriptions, medical checkups, and support
everyone’s mental health.

Luckily, you’re not alone…I mean Tricia, obviously YOU’RE not alone.

But you’ve also got CVS Health as your healthcare partner, to manage specialty medications, provide
walk-in appointments, and keep track of it all in the CVS Health app.

So, does that make everything…simple?

No. It makes it simple…er

And sometimes, “simpler” is all you need to live a little happier and healthier.

But who gets the last piece of pizza? That’s still your call.

When you need more than a pharmacy…
CVS Health.
Healthier Happens Together.

Meet the Fitzgerald family: Mom, dad, and 6 kids. Life with chronic conditions is not simple, but

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

[Patient at the Heart]

# With the Patient at the Heart

We develop software that helps people get well, helps people stay well, and helps future generations
be healthier.
[Our story →][1]

## Nurses Save Time and Keep Families Connected Using AI

At UNC Health, Riverside Health, and WakeMed, nurses reduce documentation time and improve patient &
family communication with the help of Art, Epic’s AI for clinicians.
[Learn more →][2]

## Teamwork Staff Scheduling Delivers Faster Care Coordination and Reduces Administrative Work at
## Health Systems Worldwide

Organizations report on the benefits of Teamwork—the first application in EpicOps, Epic’s integrated
Enterprise Resource Planning suite built for healthcare.
[Learn more →][3]

## UnityPoint Health Saves Lives with Better Sepsis Detection and Treatment in Pregnancy

Detection criteria and care path built into Epic EHR help clinicians identify sepsis in maternal
patients sooner and reduce time to treatment.
[Learn more →][4]

Alongside healthcare providers, Epic is taking legal action to defend patient privacy.
[Read more →][5]

# Our Software

Our software makes it possible for every patient to have a single, comprehensive medical record that
informs and is informed by their health experiences. The goal is higher-quality, more personalized
care that's simpler for patients, medical professionals, and everyone who makes healthcare happen.
[Learn more about our software →][6]

## Share What You've Done, Learn What You Can Do

[
Explore more on
[EpicShare]
][7]
[From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
Communication]

### From Phone Tag to Push Notifications: How Four Health Systems Closed the Loop on Critical Lab
### Communication

July 06, 2026
Four health systems are among those that have replaced phone calls for critical lab result
communication with Epic push notifications, achieving acknowledgement times under one
minute—compared to an average of seven to twelve minutes previously. Lab staff save approximately
ten minutes per result, which adds up to enough time saved at one organization for 15 full-time
staff members to focus on higher-value work. Clinicians acted faster on critical results, where
every minute matters.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][8]
[Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans]

### Providing Pain Relief for Sickle Cell Crises Faster with Personal, Portable Care Plans

June 22, 2026
Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust developed a digital sickle cell care program to improve
tracking and transparency of emergency pain management. The program includes personalized emergency
care plans and an ED order set. Patients went from having no digital care plans to 89% coverage, and
active patient portal usage among people with sickle cell disease increased from 43% to 58%.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][9]
[Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality]

### Using Telecritical Care to Reduce ICU Mortality

June 15, 2026
To provide expert overnight critical care, Kaiser Permanente Northern California implemented a
telecritical care program that connects remote intensivists and nurses to ICUs through real-time
monitoring, camera feeds, and instant communication. Today, the program is in use across 18 ICUs and
is associated with a 7% reduction in adjusted mortality.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][10]
[AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work]

### AI Coding Assistant Reduces Chart Review Time by 20%, Freeing Coders for Higher-Value Work

June 08, 2026
After implementing Epic’s AI Professional Billing Coding Assistant, coders at Baptist Health in
Jacksonville, Florida spend 20% less time reviewing charts—an estimated $924,000 in annual labor
savings. Clean claim rates and coder productivity have also improved.
[Read the full story on EpicShare →][11]

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

## Second Quarter 2026 Results

Second quarter 2026 results will be reviewed by management during a live audio webcast with the
financial community on July 30, 2026. The presentation will be followed by a Q&A session.

## The Power of Chasing A Dream

Every day, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives. We apply our deep
understanding of the immune system to develop breakthrough innovations in medicines and vaccines so
you can focus on what matters most, chasing your dreams. If you’re chasing your dreams, remember...
you’re not alone. **We’re right beside you**

# **Apollo 24|7 - Your Most Trusted Healthcare Brand**

Apollo 24|7 is the largest multi-channel digital healthcare platform in India, created with a vision
of eliminating flexibility blockages from the healthcare industry. We believe in making healthcare
affordable to everyone by combining analytic excellence, affordable cost, and extensive research
with advanced technology. Apollo 24|7 is a single online platform where you have access to a wide
range of services such as online pharmacy, [*online doctor consultations*][97], and diagnostic [*lab
tests at home*][98]. We also provide expert solutions for chronic conditions and COVID-care with a
secured digital vault, where you can safely upload all your medical reports. 

## **The Smart Choice for Your Health is Here**

Make the best decision for your health by choosing Apollo 24|7. Here’s why you can count on us:
* 40 years of legacy in the healthcare industry
* 24x7 availability of doctors
* More than 10 million diagnostic tests each year
* 2000+ collection centres and 100+ laboratories
* High quality diagnostic solutions 
* Fast and accurate test report results
* Several medical specialties under one roof
* Order medicines and book tests online with ease
* Digitised health queries

**Ask a Doctor Online 24/7**
Online doctor consultations take place through online doctor chat, call, or video call. This helps
you to talk to doctors online from the comfort of your home by simply choosing a doctor from
different specialties. Avail personalised solutions for any health problem with prompt online doctor
consultation with Apollo 24|7.
* Safe and secure platform
* Video and chat options

**Online Doctor Consultation - Now at Your Fingertips**
The demand for doctors is expected to increase as new medicines allow people to live longer.
However, there are several ways to reach out to a doctor without the need to visit a hospital or
clinic, all thanks to technology. With the online facility available, doctor consultations have
become easier, and you can get the right health care. Online doctor consultations with 5000+ top
medical doctors are available at Apollo 24|7. Video call or chat with expert doctors from 100+
medical specialties, including | [Dermatology][99] | [Gynaecology][100] | [Paediatrics][101] |
[Psychiatry][102] | [General Physicians][103] | [Gastroenterology][104] | [Dietetics][105] | [Ent
Specialists][106] | and more, in just 15 minutes.

Benefits of choosing online doctor consultations:
* Save time, money, and effort.
* No need to travel. 
* Most convenient option to choose from, and helps in early diagnosis.
* Online doctor consultations are confidential and safe.
* No risks of infections.

## **Apollo Hospitals**

Apollo 24|7 is a part of Apollo Hospitals. [Apollo Hospitals][107] was established in 1983 by Dr.
Prathap C Reddy. It incorporates over 10,000 beds across 70 hospitals, over 4000 pharmacies, 172
primary care and diagnostic clinics, and 148 telemedicine facilities spread across 13 countries.
Apollo Hospitals has touched billions of lives by offering exceptional clinical outcomes.

Milestones of Apollo Hospitals:
* 40 Years of legacy and credibility in the healthcare industry. 
* NABL certified multi-channel digital healthcare platform.
* World’s best medical specialists.
* Largest & trusted branded healthcare network.
* Advanced healthcare technology.
   

**Pharmacy Simplified with Apollo 24|7**
Apollo pharmacy is the most credible and established online pharmacy in India. It delivers 100%
original medicines and products. Apollo pharmacy is believed to offer super-fast home delivery for
all the healthcare essentials. Explore our broad range of  products such as baby care, personal
care, wellness, lifestyle, health, and nutrition categories online with ease. 

Rapid deliveries of medicines are available online at Apollo Pharmacy. In some cities, deliveries
are done in less than 24 hours.
* Get health credits on purchasing medicines and products.
* Alluring deals on medicines and other products.
* A broad range of medicines and essential healthcare products to choose from.
* Authentic and top-notch quality products.


**Convenient Diagnostic Lab Tests at Home**
Regular health check-ups are vital for a healthy life because it helps in detecting diseases at the
earliest, following a timely treatment. Apollo 24|7 provides blood sample testing at your doorstep
conveniently. You can book lab tests at home and utilise the home-collection facility. We offer a
broad range of diagnostic lab tests such as [*Full Body Checkup*][108]* |*[* Hba1c Test*][109]*

# **Apollo 24|7 - Your Most Trusted Healthcare Brand**

Apollo 24|7 is the largest multi-channel digital healthcare platform in India, created with a vision
of eliminating flexibility blockages from the healthcare industry. We believe in making healthcare
affordable to everyone by combining analytic excellence, affordable cost, and extensive research
with advanced technology. Apollo 24|7 is a single online platform where you have access to a wide
range of services such as online pharmacy, [*online doctor consultations*][97], and diagnostic [*lab
tests at home*][98]. We also provide expert solutions for chronic conditions and COVID-care with a
secured digital vault, where you can safely upload all your medical reports.

consultation with Apollo 24|7.

# Changing what it means to live with diabetes

##### Resource

From early warning signs to emergency treatment, this guide explains how to recognize and manage low
blood sugar.

Learn More About Low Blood Sugar

Your Diabetes Technology Guide

This playbook explains diabetes complications—from early warning signs to prevention and
treatment—so you can protect your health.

The Complications Playbook

][231]

## Who We Serve

Through platforms, programs, resources and grants, we are uniting the global diabetes community and
providing solutions to improve lives. We aim to change what it means to live with chronic illness.

[

##### People living with
##### Type 1

Living with type 1 diabetes means managing blood sugar daily, but it’s possible to thrive with the
right tools and support.

][232] [

##### Prediabetes

Diagnosed with prediabetes? You’re not alone. While it can feel overwhelming, you have the ability
to make lifestyle changes that can bring your blood glucose levels back to normal.

][233] [

##### People living with
##### Type 2

With the right resources, programs and power of our combined voices, we can redefine what it means
to be a person living with diabetes—of any type.

][234] [

##### Type 1 Caretakers

Being a caretaker for people living with diabetes means providing essential support with tasks like
blood sugar monitoring, meal planning, and managing medication.

][235] [

##### Type 2 Caretakers

Being a caretaker is a role that requires patience, understanding, and adaptability to help ensure
their health and well-being while navigating the emotional aspects of care.

][236] [

##### Advocates

Advocates for people living with diabetes play a vital role in improving the lives of those affected
by this condition.

][237] [

##### Healthcare Providers

Helping to educate healthcare providers with the latest news about diabetes from industry and the
community.

][238]

# About Us

### CHT - Global Silicone Experts

CHT further strengthened its position as a global producer of speciality silicone elastomers and
rubber with the acquisition of the ICM silicones Group in 2017 which included Quantum Silicones, ACC
Silicones, ICM Products, Amber Silicones and Treco SRL. Now operating under the CHT brand, the
expanded group includes manufacturing plants and technical laboratories in Germany, Austria, United
Kingdom, Italy, North America and China.

Sales and technical support are provided through an international network of CHT offices and
partners located in over 60 countries around the world in all continents.

# About Us

### CHT - Global Silicone Experts

CHT further strengthened its position as a global producer of speciality silicone elastomers and
rubber with the acquisition of the ICM silicones Group in 2017 which included Quantum Silicones, ACC
Silicones, ICM Products, Amber Silicones and Treco SRL. Now operating under the CHT brand, the
expanded group includes manufacturing plants and technical laboratories in Germany, Austria, United
Kingdom, Italy, North America and China.

Sales and technical support are provided through an international network of CHT offices and
partners located in over 60 countries around the world in all continents.
* silicone elastomers
* silicone fluids
* silicone emulsions
* silicone antifoams
* silicone adhesive sealants
* silicone coatings

### Technical Capabilities 

Building upon its vast experience and expertise as a speciality chemical
company, the CHT Group offers silicone materials using a diverse range of base chemistries. These
chemistries enable products to be formulated to meet the specific processing needs and physical
demands of very different industries. 

CHT has the capability to manufacture both 1-Part and 2-Part silicone compounds which will cure
at either room temperature (RTV) or by using heat. Crosslinking systems include condensation
cure, using tin and addition cure, using platinum. Within our range, we have recently developed
LSR’s (Liquid Silicone Rubber). These liquid silicone elastomers are specifically designed for the
use in fully automated industrial processes such as LIMS (Liquid Injection Moulding Systems). 

Additionally, we can support you with our highly specialised formulating additives and master
batches which will offer total flexibility when creating your own formulations. Our silicones can
also be supplied as aqueous liquids using our sophisticated emulsification technology. 

If you need assistance with your product selection, the CHT technical team
are available to share application-based advice. Developing bespoke products that meet all your
design and functional requirements, is also one part of our core business.

For further information about the CHT Group see our [Company Profile][125] page.

# NHS website for England Find information and services to help you manage your health

## [Health A to Z][8]

Find out about conditions, symptoms, medicines, tests and treatments, including when to get help

## [NHS services][9]

Find out about NHS services including GPs, pharmacies, prescriptions, hospitals and dentists

## Manage your health
* [ Order a repeat prescription ][10]
* [ View your test results ][11]
* [ Appointments and bookings at your GP surgery ][12]
* [ How to register with a GP surgery ][13]
* [ Find your NHS number ][14]

## NHS services
* [ Find a pharmacy ][15]
* [ Find a dentist ][16]
* [ Find a GP ][17]
* [ Find NHS talking therapies for anxiety and depression ][18]

[ Find other NHS services ][19]

### Help from NHS 111

If you're worried about a symptom and not sure what help you need, NHS 111 can tell you what to do
next.

Go to [111.nhs.uk][20] or [call 111][21].

For a life-threatening emergency call 999.

## Featured
* ### [ Book a COVID-19 vaccination appointment ][22]
  
  If you're eligible for the spring COVID-19 vaccine, you can book a vaccination appointment now
* ### [ Get healthcare cover abroad with a UK GHIC or EHIC ][23]
  
  Get or renew your health insurance card to help you get healthcare in the EU and some other
  countries
* ### [ Refer yourself for help for back and joint problems ][24]
  
  Get NHS help from community musculoskeletal (MSK) services, like physiotherapy, for back and joint
  problems

## More information and advice
* ## [Vaccinations][25]
  
  Information about vaccinations for babies, children and adults, including why they're important
  and how to get them
* ## [COVID-19][26]
  
  Advice about COVID-19, including symptoms, treatments and how to avoid catching and spreading it.
* ## [Baby][27]
  
  A guide to everything you need to know about caring for a baby
* ## [Women's health][28]
  
  Information and support on health, wellbeing, conditions and screening
* ## [Contraception][29]
  
  Information about different types of contraception, including where to get them and how well they
  work

CHI is a leading nonprofit dedicated to improving the lives of children and adults living with
[Congenital Hyperinsulinism (HI)][54].

CHI provides a world of information, resources, and support to the HI community. CHI advocates on
behalf of patients for better treatments and access to care. CHI is dedicated to increasing
awareness of the disorder as it leads to more timely diagnosis and the best outcomes for patients.
CHI supports medical research for improved therapies, potential cures, and timely diagnosis. CHI
works globally because we are stronger as an international community. Cooperation across borders
fosters important advances in medicine.

HI is a life-threatening disorder that causes dangerously low blood sugar levels. Prolonged or
severe low blood sugar can cause seizures, brain damage, and even death. We hope you will partner
with us to prevent damage and death, search for better treatments, and improve the quality of life
for all HI patients.



[[International Guidelines for hyperinsulinism]][55]
NEW: The first-ever international hyperinsulinism guidelines have been published and are now
available to the public! These guidelines are a collaboration of work by HI experts around the
world, including many who are a part of the CHI Collaborative Research Network and Tai Pasquini of
the CHI staff. Patient and caregiver representatives of the CHI Congenital Hyperinsulinism
Collaborative Research Network provided the patient perspective. These guidelines are available free
of charge and can be downloaded and shared with your care team. The new recommendations include:
* Diagnosis
* Medical Management
* Surgical Management
* Discharge Planning
* Longterm Management of Patients with Hyperinsulinism

And more! Find the full guidelines by clicking [here][56].


### Open Hyperinsulinism Genes Project: Increasing Access to Genetic Testing

In 2018, Congenital Hyperinsulinism International partnered with researchers at the University of
Exeter to fund the [Open Hyperinsulinism Genes Project][57], an international genetic testing
program. As a part of our joint initiative, CHI covers the costs of genetic testing for individuals
who would otherwise be unable to receive genetic screening, regardless of their location in the
world. This partnership is helping to ensure that there are no barriers for individuals diagnosed
with this condition. To date, we have enabled 1176 individuals from 65 countries access to
comprehensive testing for 21 of the known causes of hyperinsulinism. You can find out more
information on our [Open HI Genes Project page][58] and learn how to be involved [here][59].

[Open Genes Project with Exeter]

### Recent Published Articles

[[CHI Global Registries article]][60]

**Global Registries in Congenital Hyperinsulinism**

This article characterizes HI through the experience of individuals who live with it. It includes
descriptive statistics on the birthing experience, hospitalizations, medication management, feeding
challenges, experiences with glucose monitoring devices, and the overall disease burden to provide
insights into the current data in the HI Global Registry (HIGR) and demonstrate the potential areas
of future research.

[Click here to read the article][61].


[[Article on CHI and the CRN]][62]

**Congenital Hyperinsulinism International: A Community Focused on Improving the Lives of People
Living With Congenital Hyperinsulinism**

This article describes the current challenges of living with HI including diagnosis and disease
management told from the perspective of people who live with the condition, shares family stories of
life with HI, and how Congenital Hyperinsulinism International is working to improve the lives of HI
patients and their families.

[Click here to read the article][63].


[[CHI article Orphanet]][64]

**Article on Congenital Hyperinsulinism in Infancy and Childhood**

For the first time in the medical literature, the perspective of families and patients with
congenital hyperinsulinism is published together with insights from clinical experts. In this
publication, the authors Indraneel Banerjee, Julie Raskin, Jean‑Baptiste Arnoux, Diva D. De Leon,
Stuart A. Weinzimer, Mette Hammer, David M. Kendall and Paul S. Thornton, present the key clinical
challenges and unmet needs, infused with knowledge from the patient and family perspective on daily
life with congenital hyperinsulinism.

[Read the article here][65].

CHI is a leading nonprofit dedicated to improving the lives of children and adults living with
[Congenital Hyperinsulinism (HI)][54].

CHI provides a world of information, resources, and support to the HI community. CHI advocates on
behalf of patients for better treatments and access to care. CHI is dedicated to increasing
awareness of the disorder as it leads to more timely diagnosis and the best outcomes for patients.
CHI supports medical research for improved therapies, potential cures, and timely diagnosis. CHI
works globally because we are stronger as an international community. Cooperation across borders
fosters important advances in medicine.

HI is a life-threatening disorder that causes dangerously low blood sugar levels. Prolonged or
severe low blood sugar can cause seizures, brain damage, and even death. We hope you will partner
with us to prevent damage and death, search for better treatments, and improve the quality of life
for all HI patients.



[[International Guidelines for hyperinsulinism]][55]
NEW: The first-ever international hyperinsulinism guidelines have been published and are now
available to the public! These guidelines are a collaboration of work by HI experts around the
world, including many who are a part of the CHI Collaborative Research Network and Tai Pasquini of
the CHI staff. Patient and caregiver representatives of the CHI Congenital Hyperinsulinism
Collaborative Research Network provided the patient perspective. These guidelines are available free
of charge and can be downloaded and shared with your care team. The new recommendations include:
* Diagnosis
* Medical Management
* Surgical Management
* Discharge Planning
* Longterm Management of Patients with Hyperinsulinism

And more! Find the full guidelines by clicking [here][56].


### Open Hyperinsulinism Genes Project: Increasing Access to Genetic Testing

In 2018, Congenital Hyperinsulinism International partnered with researchers at the University of
Exeter to fund the [Open Hyperinsulinism Genes Project][57], an international genetic testing
program. As a part of our joint initiative, CHI covers the costs of genetic testing for individuals
who would otherwise be unable to receive genetic screening, regardless of their location in the
world. This partnership is helping to ensure that there are no barriers for individuals diagnosed
with this condition. To date, we have enabled 1176 individuals from 65 countries access to
comprehensive testing for 21 of the known causes of hyperinsulinism. You can find out more
information on our [Open HI Genes Project page][58] and learn how to be involved [here][59].

[Open Genes Project with Exeter]



### Recent Published Articles

[[CHI Global Registries article]][60]

**Global Registries in Congenital Hyperinsulinism**

This article characterizes HI through the experience of individuals who live with it. It includes
descriptive statistics on the birthing experience, hospitalizations, medication management, feeding
challenges, experiences with glucose monitoring devices, and the overall disease burden to provide
insights into the current data in the HI Global Registry (HIGR) and demonstrate the potential areas
of future research.

[Click here to read the article][61].


[[Article on CHI and the CRN]][62]

**Congenital Hyperinsulinism International: A Community Focused on Improving the Lives of People
Living With Congenital Hyperinsulinism**

This article describes the current challenges of living with HI including diagnosis and disease
management told from the perspective of people who live with the condition, shares family stories of
life with HI, and how Congenital Hyperinsulinism International is working to improve the lives of HI
patients and their families.

[Click here to read the article][63].


[[CHI article Orphanet]][64]

**Article on Congenital Hyperinsulinism in Infancy and Childhood**

For the first time in the medical literature, the perspective of families and patients with
congenital hyperinsulinism is published together with insights from clinical experts. In this
publication, the authors Indraneel Banerjee, Julie Raskin, Jean‑Baptiste Arnoux, Diva D. De Leon,
Stuart A. Weinzimer, Mette Hammer, David M. Kendall and Paul S. Thornton, present the key clinical
challenges and unmet needs, infused with knowledge from the patient and family perspective on daily
life with congenital hyperinsulinism.

[Read the article here][65].

## What's New

[Iceberg lettuce cut in half]

### Should I See a Doctor for Cyclosporiasis?

This summer, thousands of people across the country have gotten sick after eating food contaminated
with a parasite called Cyclospora. Explosive diarrhea is the main symptom of the foodborne illness,
known as cyclosporiais. If you get sick, when should you see your healthcare provider? Here, [Keley
Brennan][12], Duke Health Nurse Practitioner who sees patients at Duke Health Family Medicine
Mooresville and Duke Health Primary Care Tall Oaks, explains what you need to know about
cyclosporiasis and how to keep you and your family healthy.

[Read Article][13]
[Dr. Hannah McMannus smiles outside text overlay reads "Conversations in Cancer: Radioligand
Therapy"]
Close Video

### Radioligand Therapy: Using a Targeted Approach to Treat Cancer

A new generation of image-guided treatments uses radioactive material to target and destroy cancer
cells with fewer side effects than standard cancer treatments. **Radioligand therapies** are
approved to treat advanced prostate cancer and neuroendocrine tumors. Clinical trials are underway
to expand this therapeutic approach to more cancer types.

Who is a candidate for radioligand therapies, and why are they so effective? In our ongoing
[Conversations in Cancer series][14], [Diane Reidy-Lagunes, MD][15], a medical oncologist at Duke
Health who specializes in [neuroendocrine tumors][16], talks to [Hannah McManus, MD][17], a medical
oncologist who treats [prostate cancer,][18] about this “smart bomb” approach and the promises it
holds for the future.

*Learn more about PLUVICTO and other radioligand therapies.*

[Read Article][19]
[Patrick Schultea shakes hands with his radiation oncologist, Paul Koffer, MD.]

### Adaptive SBRT Modifies and Targets Prostate Cancer in Real Time

Two decades after Patrick Schultea underwent treatment for [prostate cancer][20], his
prostate-specific antigen (PSA) levels began to rise, signaling that the cancer had returned.
Because tiny radioactive seeds had been implanted in his prostate at a local hospital to treat his
first bout with cancer, Schultea needed a new approach. He found it at Duke Health. Today, he’s back
to renovating his beach house and enjoying life with his family.

[Read Article][21]

first bout with cancer, Schultea needed a new approach. He found it at Duke Health. Today, he’s back
to renovating his beach house and enjoying life with his family.

## What's New

[Iceberg lettuce cut in half]

### Should I See a Doctor for Cyclosporiasis?

This summer, thousands of people across the country have gotten sick after eating food contaminated
with a parasite called Cyclospora. Explosive diarrhea is the main symptom of the foodborne illness,
known as cyclosporiais. If you get sick, when should you see your healthcare provider? Here, [Keley
Brennan][12], Duke Health Nurse Practitioner who sees patients at Duke Health Family Medicine
Mooresville and Duke Health Primary Care Tall Oaks, explains what you need to know about
cyclosporiasis and how to keep you and your family healthy.

[Read Article][13]
[Dr. Hannah McMannus smiles outside text overlay reads "Conversations in Cancer: Radioligand
Therapy"]
Close Video

### Radioligand Therapy: Using a Targeted Approach to Treat Cancer

A new generation of image-guided treatments uses radioactive material to target and destroy cancer
cells with fewer side effects than standard cancer treatments. **Radioligand therapies** are
approved to treat advanced prostate cancer and neuroendocrine tumors. Clinical trials are underway
to expand this therapeutic approach to more cancer types.

Who is a candidate for radioligand therapies, and why are they so effective? In our ongoing
[Conversations in Cancer series][14], [Diane Reidy-Lagunes, MD][15], a medical oncologist at Duke
Health who specializes in [neuroendocrine tumors][16], talks to [Hannah McManus, MD][17], a medical
oncologist who treats [prostate cancer,][18] about this “smart bomb” approach and the promises it
holds for the future.

*Learn more about PLUVICTO and other radioligand therapies.*

  many conditions, and they can occur at all ages. How many of these have you seen?
  January 16, 2026

  with a wide variety of conditions, from genetic to autoimmune to infectious to environmental.
  Learn how to identify the most common forms of hair loss.

  childhood. Although many of these are benign and self-limited, some require an extensive workup
  and close monitoring.

### Make CEU 2026 Your Most Effective CME Investment

][124]

July 16, 2026

Clinical practice is changing quickly, and busy endocrinologists need updates they can use right
away. Clinical Endocrinology Update (CEU) 2026 brings together key advances, clinical guidance, and
practical management strategies in one online program with 36 live sessions, 8 specialty tracks, and
more than 30 experts. Register now to earn CME and ABIM MOC credit online October 22–24, with no
travel required.

[ ][125]
Meetings & Events
[

### Help Shape ENDO 2027 Programming

][126]

July 23, 2026

Your ideas are essential to building a dynamic, forward-thinking program that reflects the full
breadth of our field. Share your session suggestions and symposium proposals for ENDO 2027, the
premier annual meeting in endocrinology, taking place June 5-8, 2027, in Toronto, ON, Canada. All
suggestions are due Tuesday, August 4.

### Just launched: Meet the Professor 2026

][128]

July 16, 2026

The new Endocrine Case Management: Meet the Professor (MTP) 2026 is now available. Explore 40
expert-authored chapters that dive deep into complex endocrine cases, emerging therapies, and
evolving clinical challenges. Order today to earn up to 30 CME credits and 30 ABIM MOC points.

### Pass the Boards and Study Smarter with EBR 2026

][130]

July 14, 2026

Are you ready for ABIM’s Endocrinology, Diabetes, and Metabolism Certification Exam? With over a
decade of experience, we are confident that our program will help you succeed on this test and
enhance your clinical critical thinking skills. Your registration includes a printed copy of the
Endocrine Board Review (2026) 18th Edition Book, interactive practice exams, and live study sessions
with experts. Register now

Senate HELP Committee passing the INSULIN Act and the SAFE Drugs Act; and our campaign urging
Congress to pass the Right to IVF Act.

## **Welcome to Florida Medical Clinic Orlando Health**

At Florida Medical Clinic Orlando Health, we make it personal — delivering the kind of compassionate
care we would want for ourselves and our families.

By combining compassionate local care with the expertise and resources of Orlando Health, we’re able
to provide patients with expanded access to comprehensive healthcare services throughout the region.

Our providers care for patients across a wide range of specialties, including family medicine,
internal medicine, cardiology, orthopedics, gastroenterology, rheumatology and more.

From preventive care and wellness visits to advanced specialty treatment and chronic condition
management, we’re committed to delivering care that is connected, convenient and centered around
you.

Because healthcare is personal — and we believe your care should be too.

READ MORE +

## Complete Care is Right Around the Corner.

Beyond keeping you healthy, complete care also needs to be convenient. That’s why we have more than
350 medical providers, including primary care and specialists in more than 40 medical disciplines.
And we’re all connected by one electronic health record so any doctor or specialist can access your
medical history at the touch of a button. It’s all about making complete care as accessible and
effortless as it is comprehensive.

By combining compassionate local care with the expertise and resources of Orlando Health, we’re able

internal medicine, cardiology, orthopedics, gastroenterology, rheumatology and more.

From preventive care and wellness visits to advanced specialty treatment and chronic condition
management, we’re committed to delivering care that is connected, convenient and centered around
you.

Because healthcare is personal — and we believe your care should be too.

medical history at the touch of a button. It’s all about making complete care as accessible and
effortless as it is comprehensive.

# We focus solely on the assessment, treatment, and ongoing care of patients with endocrine
# disorders or requiring endocrine therapy.

## [Osteoporosis Bone Diseases][26]

Our bones continually grow and change throughout our lives. As old bone cells dissolve, new cells
grow back.

[Read More][27]

## [Obesity & Weight Management][28]

Obesity can trigger several endocrine conditions, conditions such as diabetes, Cushing's syndrome,
and polycystic ovarian syndrome.

[Read More][29]

## [Diabetes][30]

Diabetes is any of the disorders that are associated with the poor functioning of the hormone
insulin. Insulin is produced by the pancreas to help the body.

[Read More][31]

## [Pituitary Disease][32]

Pituitary diseases are disorders associated with the pituitary gland. The pituitary gland is located
in the brain and produces essential hormones.

[Read More][33]

## [Adrenal Glands][34]

The adrenal glands are two small triangular glands that sit on top of each of the kidneys. They
produce three essential hormones.

[Read More][35]

## [Thyroid Gland][36]

The Thyroid gland is responsible for producing and releasing thyroid hormones into the bloodstream.
Thyroid hormones regulate the chemical activities.

[Read More][37]

## [Men’s Health][38]

The endocrine system plays a vital role in men's health. Testosterone is the most important male
hormone.

[Read More][39]

## [Women’s Health][40]

Hormones play a critical role in women's health. Estrogen and progesterone hormones have huge
effects.

[Read More][41]

## [Gestational Diabetes and Endocrine Disorders][42]

Rapid hormonal changes occur during pregnancy. Both mother and foetus adapt.

[Read More][43]

# Obesity and Weight Management

Obesity is a chronic condition necessitating long-term management. Obesity management mirrors the
approach to conditions like high blood pressure or diabetes, requiring consistent attention. Just as
untreated hypertension or diabetes worsen over time, neglecting obesity leads to relapse. Therefore,
effective obesity management strategies must prioritize realism and sustainability, avoiding
short-term "quick fixes" that often result in weight regain.

[LEARN MORE][44]

# About Dr. Badshah

Dr. Badshah is a Consultant Physician & Endocrinologist. Dr. Badshah is passionate about his
patients and values communications with all primary care physicians.

He works privately at Hollywood Private Hospital. At Hollywood, he also has private admitting rights
in General Medicine and he also has a public appointment at Sir Charles Gairdner Hospital. He
believes in system level patient care delivery and established the Gestational Diabetes clinic at
Joondalup Hospital and worked as a Obstetric Endocrinologist at Joondalup Hospital for 2 years.

[LEARN MORE][45]

We appreciate your faith in choosing us to attend to you and your loved ones' concerns and we value

# We focus solely on the assessment, treatment, and ongoing care of patients with endocrine
# disorders or requiring endocrine therapy.

## [Osteoporosis Bone Diseases][26]

Our bones continually grow and change throughout our lives. As old bone cells dissolve, new cells
grow back.

[Read More][27]

## [Obesity & Weight Management][28]

Obesity can trigger several endocrine conditions, conditions such as diabetes, Cushing's syndrome,
and polycystic ovarian syndrome.

[Read More][29]

## [Diabetes][30]

Diabetes is any of the disorders that are associated with the poor functioning of the hormone
insulin. Insulin is produced by the pancreas to help the body.

[Read More][31]

## [Pituitary Disease][32]

Pituitary diseases are disorders associated with the pituitary gland. The pituitary gland is located
in the brain and produces essential hormones.

[Read More][33]

## [Adrenal Glands][34]

The adrenal glands are two small triangular glands that sit on top of each of the kidneys. They
produce three essential hormones.

[Read More][35]

## [Thyroid Gland][36]

The Thyroid gland is responsible for producing and releasing thyroid hormones into the bloodstream.
Thyroid hormones regulate the chemical activities.

[Read More][37]

## [Men’s Health][38]

The endocrine system plays a vital role in men's health. Testosterone is the most important male
hormone.

[Read More][39]

## [Women’s Health][40]

Hormones play a critical role in women's health. Estrogen and progesterone hormones have huge
effects.

[Read More][41]

## [Gestational Diabetes and Endocrine Disorders][42]

Rapid hormonal changes occur during pregnancy. Both mother and foetus adapt.

[Read More][43]

# Obesity and Weight Management

Obesity is a chronic condition necessitating long-term management. Obesity management mirrors the
approach to conditions like high blood pressure or diabetes, requiring consistent attention. Just as
untreated hypertension or diabetes worsen over time, neglecting obesity leads to relapse. Therefore,
effective obesity management strategies must prioritize realism and sustainability, avoiding
short-term "quick fixes" that often result in weight regain.

[LEARN MORE][44]

# About Dr. Badshah

Dr. Badshah is a Consultant Physician & Endocrinologist. Dr. Badshah is passionate about his
patients and values communications with all primary care physicians.

He works privately at Hollywood Private Hospital. At Hollywood, he also has private admitting rights
in General Medicine and he also has a public appointment at Sir Charles Gairdner Hospital. He
believes in system level patient care delivery and established the Gestational Diabetes clinic at
Joondalup Hospital and worked as a Obstetric Endocrinologist at Joondalup Hospital for 2 years.

[LEARN MORE][45]

To date our community has made over 100 million downloads. It’s based on principles of collaboration, unobstructed discovery, and, most importantly, scientific progression. As PhD students, we found it difficult to access the research we needed, so we decided to create a new Open Access publisher that levels the playing field for scientists across the world. How? By making research easy to access, and puts the academic needs of the researchers before the business interests of publishers. [Authors, Editors and Institutions][10] We are a community of more than 103,000 authors and editors from 3,291 institutions spanning 160 countries, including Nobel Prize winners and some of the world’s most-cited researchers. Publishing on IntechOpen allows authors to earn citations and find new collaborators, meaning more people see your work not only from your own field of study, but from other related fields too. # Welcome to Manhattan Endocrinology, PLLC

## Upper East Side NYC Endocrinologist and Specialist for Diabetes, Thyroid and other Endocrine
## Disorders

[Book An Appt][8]

## Andrew Martorella,M.D.
## Board Certified Endocrinologist

[Andrew Martorella, MD.jpg]

Prior to starting his own practice, Dr. Martorella was a full time academic physician at Memorial
Sloan-Kettering Cancer Center. He completed his endocrinology fellowship at New York-Presbyterian
Hospital and Memorial Sloan-Kettering Cancer Center. He served as a resident in internal medicine at
Boston University Medical Center and graduated from Georgetown University School of Medicine.


Dr. Martorella is an Assistant Attending Physician at New York-Presbyterian Hospital (NYPH), has
consulting privileges at the Hospital for Special Surgery (HSS), and holds a faculty appointment as
a Clinical Assistant Professor of Medicine at the Weill Cornell Medical College. He is board
certified in Endocrinology, Diabetes, and Metabolism and has been featured in the following
publications:

 

Castle  Connolly Top  Doctor:  [2016 - 2026][9] 


Super Doctors:  2012  -  2026

 

New  York  Magazine:  2015  -  2026

## Why Choose Cleveland Clinic?

[patient centered care icon]

### Patient-centered care:

We don’t just care for your health conditions. We care about you. That means [our providers][65]
take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

[national recognition icon]

### National recognition:

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

### Collaborative providers:

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

### Research

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

### View All Resources for Providers

View our [full list of resources][98] for medical professionals, including our Alumni Association,
DrConnect, and MyPractice.

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

### Research

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

DrConnect, and MyPractice.

partner to help our team overcome regulatory and reimbursement challenges throughout the years.”

James (Jim) V. Mazzo | Executive Chairman, Neurotech

## We are Meril. We are committed to addressing unmet clinical needs around the world through our 
## innovative and path-breaking medical devices.

Consciously contributing to alleviate ailments, we partner with the global medical fraternity across
various specialties.

## Founded in 2006

Meril is an India-based, global medical device company that is dedicated to design and manufacture
clinically relevant, cutting-edge products.

## Our Purpose

Our mission is to transform healthcare by creating in-house medical solutions across specialties,
including cardiovascular, orthopedics, robotics, diagnostics, and oncology, aimed at alleviating
human suffering.

## Exploring the Edges Through Curiosity

We believe in the power of asking questions. For every "if only…", in the field of surgical and
medical intervention, we at Meril hope to turn it into a "what if…" with infinite possibilities &
outcomes.

## From the precision of the thinnest stent to the expansive possibilities of robotics our focus is
## equally dedicated to addressing current unmet clinical needs and preparing for future
## advancements

## Our dedicated research & development team collaborates with surgeons and medical experts
## worldwide, to solve present and potential global medical challenges.

## Used by Over 2000 Companies

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

[ Search now ][41]
[ Plug in our data ][42]

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

# Pharmaceutical Market Intelligence Platform

Compare drug prices, suppliers, registrations, and shortages across global pharmaceutical markets.

BOOK A PLATFORM DEMO
[product preview] Your browser does not support the video tag.

PharmaFootpath unifies global drug pricing, supplier data, registrations, shortages, and clinical
trial information into a single searchable platform. Instantly reveal market opportunities,
empowering procurement teams, wholesalers, and parallel traders to act quickly and confidently
across countries.

[MYONEX]
[RxSource]
[Eureco Pharma]
[Ideal Trade Links]
[Corex]
[Tanner Pharma]
[Ikris Pharma Network]
[Kora Healthcare]

## Pharmaceutical Market Data Is Fragmented

Pharmaceutical pricing, registrations, shortages, and supplier data are spread across national
databases, regulatory agencies, and market reports. For procurement teams and pharmaceutical
traders, gathering this information can take hours or days.

Fragmented landscape slows decision-making and limits visibility into international opportunities.

### TEAMS MUST OFTEN
* Search multiple regulatory databases
* Compare pricing between markets
* Identify licensed suppliers
* Monitor product shortages
* Track product registrations and competition

## Meet A Single Platform for Pharmaceutical Market Intelligence

PharmaFootpath aggregates pharmaceutical market data from official sources and organizes it in a
searchable cloud platform. Users can explore pharmaceutical markets in seconds, not hours.

[pill icon]

### Drug Price Comparison

Compare drug prices by country and spot new market opportunities.

[suppliers icon]

### Supplier Discovery

Find licensed distributors and wholesalers globally.

[shortage icon]

### Shortage Monitoring

Monitor medicine shortages and supply disruptions worldwide.

[arrows icon]

### Regulatory Intelligence

Access product registrations and parallel trade licenses.

## See how PharmaFootpath works in your market

Schedule a Demo

## Get Market Clarity in Seconds

### Product Explorer

Review the registration information for multiple countries in a single unified database. Filter
information by MA holders, countries, presentations, strengths, pack sizes, and other
characteristics.

### Price Comparison

Prices are converted to the currency of your choice, with daily updated currency exchange rates.
This lets you compare prices globally in a single screen, immediately.

Order information by prices, or by the largest changes in prices over the last 30 days.

### Clinical Trial Register

Search through multiple clinical trial registers in a single interface, connected to the drug
registration data and market data of PharmaFootpath.

This helps you to select a drug name or API, and then review global clinical trials currently
running with this.

### Drug Shortage Monitoring

Monitoring drug shortages is an important task, but the volume of information can be difficult to
manage.

PharmaFootpath collects and structures shortage information into a single interface, monitoring
trends to highlight the API with which there are increasing supply disruption signals.

## Built for Pharmaceutical Trade and Procurement

### Procurement Teams

Procurement teams can efficiently search multiple markets, compare pricing, and identify suppliers.

### Parallel Traders

Parallel traders can track product registrations, monitor competition, and find arbitrage
opportunities across EU markets.

### Clinical Trial Supply Teams

Clinical trial supply teams can identify global product availability and find new sourcing
opportunities.

### Pharmaceutical Wholesalers

Pharmaceutical wholesalers can find new suppliers, partners, and international trade opportunities.

## Find sourcing opportunities across global pharmaceutical markets

Schedule a Demo

## Official Pharmaceutical Sources

PharmaFootpath gathers pharmaceutical market data from official national organizations, regulatory
databases, and verified sources. Shortage data is updated daily, and most datasets are refreshed
weekly, so users have the latest information.
* Pharmaceutical pricing
* Product registrations
* Shortages and supply disruptions
* Clinical trials
* Supplier licenses

## Trusted by Pharmaceutical Trade Professionals

> Pharma Footpath has become a valuable part of how we shape our sourcing strategy for commercial
> drugs in clinical trials. The platform gives us clear visibility of the supply landscape including
> product availability, pricing dynamics, and emerging shortages, which helps us make more informed,
> proactive sourcing decisions. It has also strengthened our internal knowledge base and improved
> how we anticipate and manage sourcing challenges.

Matt Grace

Senior Directo

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is a pharmaceutical market intelligence platform that aggregates drug prices,
supplier information, product registrations, shortages, clinical trials, and licensing data into one
searchable system for pharmaceutical traders, wholesalers, and procurement teams.

Who uses PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is used by pharmaceutical procurement teams, parallel traders, wholesalers, and
clinical trial supply companies that need visibility into pharmaceutical markets across multiple
countries.

Where does PharmaFootpath source its data?

PharmaFootpath gathers pharmaceutical market data from official national organizations, regulatory
agencies, and verified public sources to ensure reliable information.

How often is the data updated?

Medicine shortage data is updated daily, while most other datasets, such as product registrations
and pricing, are updated weekly depending on the source schedule.

What markets does PharmaFootpath cover?

PharmaFootpath focuses on European pharmaceutical markets with additional coverage for Switzerland,
UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Brazil, UAE, and Saudi Arabia.

We are continually expanding our market offerings. If you’re interested in a market not listed,
please contact us to check when it will be added!

How does PharmaFootpath help pharmaceutical procurement teams?

We identify where products are registered and commercialised, price information, who the
distributors are for the products, and various other details that accelerate sourcing products.

How does PharmaFootpath support parallel trade?

PharmaFootpath monitors and publishes both centrally authorised and national level parallel trade
licenses in Europe. We identify the origins of national parallel trade licenses, as well as review
and publish trends in the parallel trade markets.

How is PharmaFootpath different from traditional pharma data providers?

We're focussed on providing data to support international pharmaceutical businesses. Particularly
those looking to source internationally, export to new markets, identify unlicensed medicines, or
considering launching portfolio products internationally.

How can I access PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is a cloud based application, so is accessible from any laptop or PC with internet
access.

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is a pharmaceutical market intelligence platform that aggregates drug prices,
supplier information, product registrations, shortages, clinical trials, and licensing data into one
searchable system for pharmaceutical traders, wholesalers, and procurement teams.

Who uses PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is used by pharmaceutical procurement teams, parallel traders, wholesalers, and
clinical trial supply companies that need visibility into pharmaceutical markets across multiple
countries.

Where does PharmaFootpath source its data?

PharmaFootpath gathers pharmaceutical market data from official national organizations, regulatory
agencies, and verified public sources to ensure reliable information.

How often is the data updated?

Medicine shortage data is updated daily, while most other datasets, such as product registrations
and pricing, are updated weekly depending on the source schedule.

What markets does PharmaFootpath cover?

PharmaFootpath focuses on European pharmaceutical markets with additional coverage for Switzerland,
UK, USA, Canada, Australia, Brazil, UAE, and Saudi Arabia.

We are continually expanding our market offerings. If you’re interested in a market not listed,
please contact us to check when it will be added!

How does PharmaFootpath help pharmaceutical procurement teams?

We identify where products are registered and commercialised, price information, who the
distributors are for the products, and various other details that accelerate sourcing products.

How does PharmaFootpath support parallel trade?

PharmaFootpath monitors and publishes both centrally authorised and national level parallel trade
licenses in Europe. We identify the origins of national parallel trade licenses, as well as review
and publish trends in the parallel trade markets.

How is PharmaFootpath different from traditional pharma data providers?

We're focussed on providing data to support international pharmaceutical businesses. Particularly
those looking to source internationally, export to new markets, identify unlicensed medicines, or
considering launching portfolio products internationally.

How can I access PharmaFootpath?

PharmaFootpath is a cloud based application, so is accessible from any laptop or PC with internet
access.

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

## Deliverables That Drive Revenue Decisions

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

#### Analytics and Modelling

#### Insight Development

#### Actionable Deliverables

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder

and refine plans.
